scientific_scope.question: How does the reported ex vivo perfused human-heart experiment connect physiological sensing, app feedback, wireless energy and pacing, and what conditional scheme is visibly reported?
scientific_scope.analysis_unit: Isolated Langendorff-perfused human whole heart; not an in vivo human trial.
scientific_scope.claim_bound: Reported apparatus/functional control and observed traces support the experimental demonstration; no executable timing specification, clinical benefit or device approval is established by this reconstruction.

panels.A: Apparatus schematic: heart, cannula/perfusion, ECG cable, cardiac module, bioresorbable module and external control module.
panels.B: Photograph of the actual apparatus, with5cm scale; supports arrangement without resolving electrode wiring.
panels.C: Optical epicardial activation map,0–120ms scale and5mm spatial scale; observation supports activation origin, not controller input.
panels.D: Eight-stage conditional flow, with twelve directed routes; strict lower/higher threshold comparisons and a conditionally reached duration check.
panels.E: Programmed HR in bpm above measured ECG in mV on a shared time axis in seconds; manual perturbation and automatic pacing are distinct. Settings54bpm lower limit,10s duration and100bpm pacing rate belong to the example. Higher limit unknown.

visual_decomposition.layout: Apparatus schematic/photo and spatial activation evidence above a conditional flowchart and paired time traces; successive panels add different kinds of evidence rather than proving every implementation detail.
visual_decomposition.visual_roles: Source panelD uses explicit Yes/No and On/Off branches; its convergent return line returns to monitoring. Source panelE grey programmed-HR steps, red threshold/on markers and shaded pacing intervals must be read with the lower black ECG trace and separate axes.
visual_decomposition.color_and_symbols: The activation-map colorbar is a measured timing scale, not a style palette. Red threshold/markers in source do not imply source certainty or causal proof. No source image recoloring/copying performed.
visual_decomposition.limitations: Original flow and prose differ in their detail of duration handling; missing Text8/code prevents reconstructing scheduling. Compact layout does not resolve this gap.

nontransferable_or_unresolved.issue: Fig3D conditional routing versus prose duration description
nontransferable_or_unresolved.impact: The visual duration check occurs only after HR is not below the lower and not above the higher limit and stimulation is on. Prose says stop after10 s and reassess. Without Supplementary Text8/code, do not claim a complete executable scheduler or silently redraw a timer that bypasses those visible decisions.

nontransferable_or_unresolved.issue: BLE payload and precise processing placement not recovered
nontransferable_or_unresolved.impact: Text attributes HR calculation to cardiac AFE/MCU and feedback scheme to mobile app; Fig3D is functional. Do not assert all signal processing is on phone or that only HR rather than ECG reaches phone.

Fig3 is ex vivo human whole heart; rats/canines establish other capabilities and healthy humans demonstrate sensing/derived pacing signals. No in vivo human implantation or clinical outcome validation shown by this figure. Separate electrode is an experimental perturbation, not demonstrated clinician emergency override.
